name: Art Request
about: Request a new tileset, sprite, or graphic asset
title: "[ART] "
labels: art

---

## Asset Name
e.g., `eire_cliffs_coastal`

## Type
- [ ] Tileset (overworld)
- [ ] Sprite (NPC / trainer)
- [ ] UI Element
- [ ] Other

## Description
What does this asset depict? Irish cultural / geographical references?

## Style Reference
Link to screenshots from the game showing the existing art style.

## Palette Constraints
Max 16 colours. Does this share a palette with an existing tileset?

## Dimensions / Tile Count
Approximate number of unique 16×16 tiles needed.

## Priority
- [ ] Blocking (needed before next milestone)
- [ ] High
- [ ] Normal
- [ ] Low / Nice to have
